decision_conditions: STANDARD ADVERTISEMENT CONDITION (COMPLIANCE):  Any advertisement displayed and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority. No advertisement is to be displayed without permission of the owner of the site or any other people with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission. No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of any road traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air, or so as otherwise to render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway (including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
description:
Alteration to the exterior of the pub to comprise the following elements (Full planning application and Listed Building Consent also submitted refs: P2025/3041/FUL & P2025/2122/LBC)-
•	2 off new pictorial signs to existing bracket work, replacement external lights. Replacement of existing hanging signs and lights 
•	2 of internally illuminated built up sets of house name letters (face illuminated). The depth of these shall be confined to 40mm as per the relevant condition. The internal illumination is to be a warm colour as presented in the supporting documentation.
•	2 replacement menu cases internally illuminated. Replacement of existing two corner menu cases acceptable. The number has been reduced (from three originally proposed) to avoid a sense of accretion of clutter, and maintain balance to pub frontage.
•	Install of brass etched badge sign. 
•	New splayed corner hand painted fox image. 
•	8 new wall lights. 
•	8 replacement flood lights. 
•	Retain but rework existing Lantern.
